events.did: 塔拉辛在丝兰地山间猎屋醒来，发现双手被阿巴卡麻绳反绑在床柱上。
events.quote: glancing down at herself, she saw her wrists were thrust behind her, abaca ropes tying them tightly around a bedpost

events.did: 奥里亚尔为塔拉辛沏莲花茶，塔拉辛报出她继承母亲家系后的称号“达雅·费拉萨伊”。
events.quote: Talasyn wracked her sluggish brain for the name of Oryal’s mother’s house

events.did: 奥里亚尔承认自己是数千年来 dominion 首位雷击者。
events.quote: The first Thunderstruck born to the Dominion in thousands of years

events.did: 奥里亚尔把整杯热茶泼到塔拉辛脸上。
events.quote: Oryal hurled the contents of her teacup at Talasyn

events.did: 拉利娅·穆萨勒与凯·吉塔布闯入猎屋，拉利娅扇了奥里亚尔一耳光。
events.quote: She struck Oryal across the face, the latter’s head twisting to the side from the force of the blow

events.did: 塔拉辛暗中松绳，麻绳挂住了婚戒上镶嵌的乌鲁纳石。
events.quote: The rope had snagged on the vulana stone that was embedded in her wedding band

events.did: 塔拉辛高声推测三人杀她后将围攻都城、另立龙座女王，以引开注意。
events.quote: after you kill me, leaving my grandmother without an heir, your forces will lay siege to the capital and install a new Zahiya-lachis on the Dragon Throne

events.did: 奥里亚尔断言乌尔杜佳当年正是因此决定杀死塔拉辛的母亲。
events.quote: was why Urduja decided that your mother had to die

relations.relation: 囚徒与绑架者：奥里亚尔假面舞会后击昏塔拉辛，取走她的魔法并将其绑走。
relations.quote: who had knocked her out after the masquerade battle, who had taken away her magic with some kind of serum

relations.relation: 外孙女与外婆，塔拉辛是乌尔杜佳的继承人（Zahiya-lachis 之位）。
relations.quote: leaving my grandmother without an heir

relations.relation: 夫妻兼两国同盟：塔拉辛自称夜之女皇，一死则同盟破裂。
relations.quote: The Kesathese will not appreciate suddenly finding themselves without a Night Empress

relations.relation: 同谋但上下有别：拉利娅斥责并掌掴奥里亚尔，自认是“未来女王耳边的人”。
relations.quote: You foolish girl, you have jeopardized everything

relations.relation: 父女：其父死于假面舞会袭击，奥里亚尔称他并未参与此谋。
relations.quote: He had no part in this. I would never have agreed to the plan had I known

numbers.what: 多米尼恩已有多少年未出现雷击者（Oryal 自称首位）
numbers.quote: The first Thunderstruck born to the Dominion in thousands of years

numbers.what: 七重食——三人等它过去后才动手的时点
numbers.quote: you waited until after the sevenfold eclipse to carry out this little scheme
Bakun had gone back to sleep for another thousand years

numbers.what: 塔拉辛从绳隙挤进去的手指数量
numbers.quote: jam two fingers through the minuscule gap

numbers.what: 婚戒上乌鲁纳石的来历（第八月亮的碎片）
numbers.quote: The shard of the eighth moon, brighter than moissanite, sharper than diamond

numbers.what: 阿拉里克停在港口的唯一一艘风暴船
numbers.quote: He has only the one stormship at our port

notes: 全章为塔拉辛单一视角，紧接假面舞会当夜、天亮前后数小时内；她被囚于丝兰地猎屋，无异常叙述，唯末句是奥里亚尔的悬念式指控。
